partners.mechanism_chain: LHFPL5 (HGNC:26501) —DISRUPTS→ Hair cell mechanotransduction (GO:0008577); LHFPL5 (HGNC:26501) —DISRUPTS→ Inner ear development (GO:0001573); MYO7A (HGNC:7773) —DISRUPTS→ Hair cell mechanotransduction (GO:0008577); MYO7A (HGNC:7773) —DISRUPTS→ Inner ear development (GO:0001573); Hair cell mechanotransduction (GO:0008577) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365); Inner ear development (GO:0001573) —LEADS_TO→ Hearing impairment (HP:0000365). Loss-of-function mutations in LHFPL5 (ARNSHL67) and MYO7A (ARNSHL2) both disrupt critical pathways involved in hair cell mechanotransduction and inner ear development, ultimately leading to the shared phenotype of hearing impairment. The disruption of these distinct but interacting pathways within the hair cell converges to cause the same clinical outcome.
